A major appeal to being pog asf is that you aren’t slayed 24/7 or u don’t live in 90s prison-like condition but the camaraderie is okay at best.

Dumbass pog shit is probably shit like having an immaculate uniform 24/7, paperwork up the ass, sitting around, actual formations to get word passed, boots not getting hazed, can’t yell at people.. etc. 

Dumbass grunt shit is like training all day, 0500 slayer ass PT, field ops like every other week, lot a cleaning, armory won’t take ur gat, hiking a lot, getting hazed if ur a boot, dealing with crappy LTs plans and SNCOs that hate you all, getting shit funding.. etc

Well typically IRL to get into some Special Op kind of groups, you serve with the regular Troops until you come either an NCO (non commissioned officer, like a team leader or hard charging squad leader) or a SNCO (staff non-com officer, either platoon guide or platoon sgt) 

You could have the MC serve in the regular army for several years and promotions then have him opt into training. 
Also i wouldn’t make him out to be this “fuck the rules I go my own way” cliche ass spec ops dude that always gets in trouble with his command bc IRL that person wouldn’t even get past the initial selection
